title: Set feature size to max(WMBT size, Footprint size) and split features over limits

facts.note: Feature plan files are identifiable by artifact kind/location in the planning tree.
Fires whenever a feature plan is authored, modified (any field, including prose) or validated; the invariant holds for every feature plan, not only sizing edits.

values: size field set, changed or missing
facts.note: Diff/field-level observer on feature documents, including detection of absent sizing fields.

values: size unverifiable because covers_wmbts or footprint is missing
facts.note: Feature-sizing validator computing the WMBT bracket from covers_wmbts and footprint points, run over existing as well as new feature plans.
Planning task wording that touches features or their validation.

fires: Planner authors a new feature plan, with or without sizing fields filled in yet.
Planner adds or removes WMBTs in covers_wmbts of an existing feature.
Planner adds components, events, tables, jobs or integrations to a feature's footprint.
Planner makes a prose-only edit to a feature whose existing size is wrong or whose footprint already exceeds a limit.
Planner validates/reviews existing feature plans, including ones missing size, covers_wmbts or footprint.
A feature's footprint exceeds the component/event limits or the hard limits for tables/jobs/integrations.
doesNotFire: Editing a wagon, WMBT or acceptance document when no feature plan's sizing inputs or validity are affected.
Coder implementation work in application layers that does not touch planning artifacts.

given: Any feature plan (new or existing, with or without complete size, covers_wmbts and footprint fields)
when: The planner creates, edits (including prose-only) or validates that feature plan
then: Ensure the feature's size field is present and equals exactly max(WMBT size, Footprint size), with the WMBT bracket from covers_wmbts and the Footprint size from the footprint point score.
prefer: Derive the WMBT size bracket from covers_wmbts and score the footprint with the point system (defined in planner.feature.size-max-rule); take the larger.
Split a feature whose footprint exceeds component/event limits; always split one exceeding hard limits (tables/jobs/integrations); limit values come from planner.feature.hard-limits.
If covers_wmbts or footprint is missing, fill it in from the feature's scope before setting size; do not guess a size without both inputs.
avoid: A size differing from max(WMBT size, Footprint size), e.g. using only one of the two.
Leaving an over-limit feature unsplit, even when only editing its prose.
Trimming covers_wmbts or under-reporting footprint to lower size or dodge a limit.
why: The convention defines feature size as the larger of the WMBT bracket and the footprint's architectural-complexity score, and requires features over component/event or hard limits to be split.
evidence: Validator recomputes WMBT size from covers_wmbts and Footprint size from footprint points and checks size == max of the two; a missing size field is a failure.
Where covers_wmbts or footprint is missing, the validator reports the size as unverifiable (not as passing).
Validator checks footprint counts against component/event limits and hard limits (tables/jobs/integrations); any excess without a split is a failure.
verifier_detail: size field must equal max(WMBT size, Footprint size).
covers_wmbts determines the WMBT size bracket.
Footprint scores architectural complexity using a point system.
Features exceeding component/event limits must be split.
Features exceeding hard limits (tables/jobs/integrations) MUST be split.
Term validation_rule: a feature sizing/limit validation rule.
Graph: requires planner.feature.hard-limits (limit values) and planner.feature.size-max-rule (max rule definition).
Run over all feature plans (existing and new), not only changed sizing fields.
audit: statement: A feature's size must equal max(WMBT size, Footprint size); features exceeding component/event/hard limits must be split.

additions.text: Splitting on exceeded limits (S011, S012) is an independent obligation; propose planner.feature.split-on-limits (possibly merged with planner.feature.hard-limits).
additions.justification: Rule 2: one obligation in then; split obligation kept in prefer/avoid meanwhile.

additions.text: Trimming covers_wmbts or under-reporting footprint to lower size or dodge a limit.
additions.justification: Metric-gaming anti-pattern implied by the sizing rule; not literally in source.

additions.text: 'present' — a missing size field is treated as a violation (evidence[0]).
additions.justification: Source requires size to equal the max; an absent size cannot satisfy that, so plans missing sizing fields are in scope.

additions.text: prefer[2]: if covers_wmbts or footprint is missing, fill it in before setting size; do not guess a size without both inputs.
additions.justification: Reviewer usability risk: planner needs guidance for incomplete plans. This is guidance on how to satisfy the size rule, not a new completeness requirement; the source itself does not require these fields independently.

additions.text: evidence[1]: missing covers_wmbts/footprint is reported as 'size unverifiable', not as an automatic failure and not as a pass.
additions.justification: Replaces the previous undeclared automatic failure for missing sizing inputs (auditor finding); the source only implies size cannot be confirmed without its inputs.
